beats.role_note: COLD OPEN LAW — ask shown answered; plain ask-focused hook, no self-intro here (see B00B)
beats.narration_text: I asked Claude to help me dig into something I kept seeing repeated — that AI is quietly solving one of the oldest problems in nonprofit marketing, without much fanfare about it. Not the flashy kind of AI story. Just a quieter, more useful one.

props.command: claude "help me understand how AI is actually helping nonprofit marketing teams"
props.segment: The Nonprofit Marketing Problem AI Is Quietly Solving
output: one thing AI still can't do

beats.role_note: presenter intro — 'Hi, I'm Agrima' self-introduction + a short lead-in to the topic, matching the two-threads-one-week B01 / death-of-the-generic-resume B00B precedent
beats.narration_text: Hi, I'm Agrima. I want to talk about something I've seen firsthand, working on the Loon Project — how much AI is quietly helping small nonprofit teams keep up with work they were genuinely never staffed for.
beats.visual_intent: presenter card: name, then a short lead-in naming the Loon Project connection

beats.narration_text: Nonprofit marketing has always asked a lot from very few people. A five-person organization is often expected to handle the exact same donor outreach, storytelling, and campaign work as a company with a much larger team — but with a fraction of the budget, and usually just one person covering several roles at once.
beats.visual_intent: one central 'One person.' card with four role tags (Outreach, Storytelling, Campaigns, Fundraising) fanning out and connecting to it

beats.narration_text: That's the gap AI is starting to close, and I think it's making a real difference. More than half of nonprofits are now piloting or actively using AI tools — and it isn't just early adopters experimenting. About thirty percent report that AI has directly increased their fundraising revenue over the past year.
beats.visual_intent: two stacked stat lines: '50%+ of nonprofits piloting or using AI' and '~30% report a direct revenue increase'

beats.narration_text: The part I find most interesting is donor personalization, because this is where AI stops being just a time-saver and starts genuinely improving results. Personalized emails that reflect what a specific donor actually cares about — rather than a generic message to the whole list — reportedly double open and click-through rates.
beats.visual_intent: before/after email mockup: a flat 'GENERIC' card next to a highlighted 'PERSONALIZED' card, stat line '~2x open + click-through' beneath

beats.narration_text: I also want to be fair about the limits here, because 'AI will fix nonprofit marketing' is its own kind of overstatement. AI can draft a donor email quickly. But it can't decide what the organization actually wants to say, or whether the message is honest. That part stays entirely human — and I think it should.
beats.visual_intent: two-line contrast card: 'AI can draft fast.' / 'It can't decide what to say.' + a smaller line, 'That part stays human.'

beats.role_note: Loon Project callback, the stakes — SHOW
beats.narration_text: For something like the Loon Project, or any small mission-driven team trying to do real work with very little staff to spare on communications, that's not a small convenience. It's often the difference between having a real public presence, and not having one at all — which, for a project this small, is the whole ballgame.
beats.visual_intent: three-line closing typographic beat ending on the stakes, captioned '— the Loon Project'

beats.role_note: HANDOFF LAW — prompt read aloud AND discussed
beats.narration_text: Your turn. If you're on a small team like this one, ask Claude to help you find one AI tool you could actually start using this week — for donor outreach, or fundraising, or just keeping up. Small teams don't need every tool out there. Just the right one, used well.

claude "help me find one AI tool my team could
  actually start using this week for donor outreach"
props.segment: The Nonprofit Marketing Problem AI Is Quietly Solving

beats.role_note: OUTRO LAW — title restate, last beat
beats.narration_text: That's the short version. The full video also gets into the specific tasks AI is automating, the real numbers behind donation-form optimization, and why this isn't really a top-down story.
